assertion.statement: After lifting the actual augmented upper-triangular model over Lambda[G] and cancelling new local blocks, every sign evaluation of the inverse blocks and old-rank Schur differential has Laurent order at least -4M modulo2^M, uniformly in block count; adjacent surviving differentials are unchanged.
